stats.notes: From IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2023 first-time students): 13,542 applicants, 11,486 admitted, 5,634 enrolled. College Navigator fall 2024: 18,377 applicants, 94% admitted. IPEDS reports no nonresident-alien applicant counts for UTRGV, so no international admit figures are shown; nonresidents are about 2% of undergraduates (fall 2024, rounded). Undergraduate enrollment 28,674 and student-faculty ratio 20:1 are fall 2024 College Navigator figures. No readable Common Data Set was found for this college, so these are IPEDS figures only; GPA, residency and class-rank details are not included.

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25: tuition and fees in-state $9,987, out-of-state $19,827; on-campus food and housing $9,728, other expenses $3,918. The total cost of attendance shown is the published out-of-state on-campus total (the rate an international student would normally face; UTRGV does not publish a separate international tuition rate on the pages checked)
